friendly_name: Landed worktree cleanup and upgrade worktree scope
purpose_context: Landing worktrees and their local branches pile up after their PRs merge because no step removes them; one clone held 48 stale worktrees using about 36 GB. Upgrade then writes and commits into every one of them, including open PR branches. This Mission gives operators a provable, offline prune surface and makes upgrade leave non-Mission worktrees alone unless named (#7173).
purpose_tldr: Report and safely prune worktrees whose work has landed, and stop upgrade committing into non-Mission worktrees by default.
